title: Ideal-power torsion detected on finite localization charts
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $t\geq0$, $f:\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\to R$, and $I=(f_0,\ldots,f_{t-1})$. Let $M,N$ be $R$-modules and $g:M\to N$ an $R$-linear map. Localization is as in [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Then the kernel and cokernel of $g$ are $I$-power torsion (every element is annihilated by all elements of some $I^n$, $n\geq0$) if and only if the induced localization map $M_{f_i}\to N_{f_i}$ is bijective for every $i$.

source.place: Lemma 0ALK, proof of part (1), first sentence; Proposition 05ER, vanishing of localized kernels and cokernels; step 7 of thm-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0ALK and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05EL on 2026-10-13

proof.text: For any module L, I-power torsion implies L localized at each f_i is zero: f_i^n lies in I^n and kills each numerator. Conversely, if all these localizations vanish, each f_i has a power in the annihilator J of a given x. Thus I is contained in the radical of J, and finite generation gives I^n contained in J. Use Mathlib LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff and Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg. The zero ideal from an empty family also satisfies this conclusion.

Localization commutes with kernels and cokernels. Identify the localized kernel with the kernel of the localized map using Mathlib LinearMap.toKerLocalized_isLocalizedModule and IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv. Its being zero is injectivity. Mathlib LinearMap.localizedMap_surjective_iff_subsingleton_localized_coker identifies vanishing of the localized cokernel with surjectivity. Apply the preceding criterion to both modules and combine injectivity and surjectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem idealPowerTorsion_iff_localMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type v} {N : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → R) (g : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    ((∀ x : g.ker, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ r ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ^ n, r • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x : N ⧸ g.range,
        ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ r ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) ^ n, r • x = 0)) ↔
      ∀ i : Fin t, Function.Bijective
        (IsLocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers (f i))
          (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (f i)) M)
          (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (f i)) N) g)
